x: Tania Sturton (U20W) and Debbie Hearn (U17W) have both been selected to represent Surrey in the Inter-County Championships to be held at Cardiff on March 1st. Also, keep a look out for Rachel Weston who has been awarded an Elite number for the Flora London Marathon.

Rachel Weston's fine 7th place shows what an asset she is going to be for the club while Tania Sturton, our second runner home, took the silver medal for overall second place in the Junior Women's category.

A couple more to join Nikki Haines and Rachel Weston and we might have figured in the women's team race. Dave McMillan looked absolutely awful as he clawed his way along Upper Thames Street with a couple of miles to go.
